title: Design a gated VCF 9.1 workload-domain convergence
prompt:
Produce the executable architecture for adding the workload domain described in `fixtures/estate-inventory.json` to the existing VCF fleet. The management domain is already at its intended level and must remain unchanged. The workload estate is mixed-version: an apparently natural component-by-component upgrade order crosses an unsupported combination, so the migration must route through a supported VCF-managed path.

Before implementing, research current Broadcom-published compatibility, interoperability, upgrade-path, and VCF 9.1 upgrade-sequence material. Record the source title, URL, consultation date, and the specific conclusion used in `research.md`.

Implement the design as a Go package in `architecture/` and a runnable `cmd/vcf-architecture` command. The command must read the inventory and write `out/architecture.json`; architecture generation must have no runtime network dependency. Add your own table-driven Go tests. The complete package must pass `go test -race ./...`.

`out/architecture.json` is the architecture, not a prose report. Its top level must be an `SddcSpec` conforming to the SddcSpec schema in the VMware Cloud Foundation Installer API 9.1.0.0 contract. It must also satisfy `schemas/architecture-output.schema.json`. Populate its installer fields from the fixture, model the existing vCenter and NSX as existing deployments, preserve every management-domain component at its current version, and include an ordered `migrationPlan`.

The migration plan must name every workload component from the inventory, state each current and supported final target version, and attach only gates required by the researched path. Each ordered step must name its action and all component transitions it performs. The sequence must be executable from the fixture's starting state: every transition must be supported, every required gate and predecessor action must be present, no intermediate state may match a forbidden combination, and every workload component must finish at its inventory target. Do not add migration steps for management-domain components.

The verifier, schemas, specification, inventory, and `architecture/contract_test.go` must remain unchanged. Run `python3 -B verifier/verify.py` for the full check.
